query:
The club operates with the understanding that everyone shares their Strava after every ride. Based on the conversations, does this apply to every member equally? If not, who treats this differently in practice, and what in their behaviour shows it?

Options:
A. Lena and Marcus
B. Tomás and Ben
C. Derek and Yuki
D. Saoirse and Priya
context:
[1] (about=Callum, episodic, t12 @2026-02-21T12:15:00) Priya mentioned half the group thought I did not like them. Wanted to address that directly. I am here for the riding but I am also just not great at group chat. Not personal.
[2] (about=Priya, episodic, t12 @2026-02-21T12:08:00) ok Marcus admitting a 55km ride counts as a ride is genuinely historic, screenshot this everyone 📸
[3] (about=Ben, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T13:40:00) haha for the record I think the café is what makes the ride worth doing. not just the ride itself. the whole thing, travel there, suffer a bit, then sit somewhere warm and eat something good.
[4] (about=Callum, episodic, t18 @2026-03-14T14:08:00) Full season data pack will be in the Strava group by Wednesday. 10 sessions, 9 members, 783.4km total group distance.
[5] (about=GROUP, said_by=Derek, group-insight, t16 @2026-03-07T13:12:00) Derek said today's ride was well-paced across the board; the Saoirse-at-social-tempo experiment works.
[6] (about=Lena, episodic, t10 @2026-02-14T12:16:00) From a physio perspective that is actually an ideal model. You get the social element and the movement without the load that would compound fatigue. I am happy to run that loop with you whenever the main route does not suit. It is genuinely good periodisation.
[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t0 @2026-01-10T09:36:00) Right, route file sent to Tomás. He will share the GPX Thursday evening so everyone has it loaded. No last-minute nav questions on the day.
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Priya, group-interaction, t14 @2026-02-28T12:17:00) Group agrees to weekly rides; no objections.
[9] (about=GROUP, said_by=Saoirse, group-interaction, t14 @2026-02-28T12:17:00) Saoirse agrees to not set race tempo on group rides.
[10] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tomás, group-interaction, t5 @2026-01-31T09:05:00) Ride cancelled due to 35mph north wind, gusting higher on ridge. Next ride next Saturday.
agent_answer:
No — it does **not** apply equally. The people who treat it differently are **Lena and Marcus** (option A).

- **Marcus** – Priya’s remark that Marcus “admitting a 55km ride counts as a ride is genuinely historic” shows he had previously not been counting/logging shorter rides as real rides. So in practice he does not share every ride on Strava, only ones he deems long enough.
- **Lena** – she says she is happy to run “that loop” whenever the main route does not suit, meaning she sometimes does her own ride instead of the standard group route. So she does not always participate in — and therefore does not always share — the same group ride.
